title: Carpentry services | Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction
description: Bespoke carpentry services & renovation experts in Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds & Cambridge. Joinery, extensions, kitchens & media walls crafted with care.
bannerSubtext: From bespoke joinery to full-scale builds: trusted carpentry services tailored to your home.

intro.html: At Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, carpentry is at the heart of everything we do. Since 2013, we’ve been delivering quality carpentry services across Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge and beyond, from intricate bespoke joinery to full-scale extensions, conversions and renovations.

With over 40 years of combined experience, our NVQ-qualified carpenters bring both traditional skills and modern techniques to every project. We’re a small, friendly company that takes pride in managing not just the carpentry, but all the details that make a home feel complete.

chapters.heading: Local Carpenter for Carpentry Services in Cambridgeshire

blocks.html: As your trusted local carpenter, we design and craft fitted wardrobes, bespoke bookcases, shelving, cabinetry and one-off pieces. Every project is created with care, tailored to your needs, and built to stand the test of time.

chapters.heading: Carpentry Services for House Extensions & Renovations

blocks.html: From brick-built to timber-framed, our carpentry services for house extensions cover every stage: trusses, roofing, Hardiplank cladding, and internal carpentry. We also offer full renovation works, transforming tired properties into fresh, modern living spaces. Every extension, renovation or conversion is delivered to blend seamlessly with your home.

blocks.html: An unused garage is an opportunity waiting to be unlocked. With our carpentry services for garage conversions, we can create stylish home offices, gyms, living spaces or guest rooms. We take care of stud walls, flooring, insulation and finishing carpentry so the space feels as natural as any other room in your home.

Our bespoke media walls are designed around you, incorporating shelves, cabinets, sound bars and speaker storage to keep everything neat and functional. It’s the perfect way to transform your living room into a space that feels both modern and organised.

chapters.heading: Bespoke Carpenter & Joinery for Kitchen Fitting

blocks.html: Kitchens are the hub of any home. Our carpentry services for kitchen fitting include bespoke kitchens, fitted units, doors, worktops and kitchen islands. Whether you prefer sleek modern lines or a more traditional finish, we’ll deliver a kitchen that’s practical, stylish, and built to last.

Not all projects fit neatly into a category. That’s why we also offer bespoke carpentry and joinery services, from fitted wardrobes to feature staircases. With a multi-skilled tradesman leading the team, and access to trusted groundworkers, bricklayers and plasterers, we’re able to take on complex projects with confidence.
